mapper.select: SELECT `meter_a` `meterA`,`meter_b` `meterB` FROM `power_distribution_box` WHERE `device_id` = #{deviceId} and `statistical_method` = 'ELECTRICITY' ORDER BY `collect_time` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.`device_id` `transformerMeterCode`, a.`meter_a` `transformerMeterA`, a.`meter_b` `transformerMeterB`, a.`current_quantity` `transformerCurrentQuantity`, b.`device_id` `powerMeterCode`, b.`meter_a` `powerMeterA`, b.`meter_b` `powerMeterB`, b.`current_quantity` `powerCurrentQuantity` FROM `transformer_meter` a LEFT JOIN `power_distribution_box` b ON a.`distribution_device` = b.`device_id` WHERE a.`statistical_method` = 'ELECTRICITY' and b.`statistical_method` = 'ELECTRICITY' and a.`collect_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and b.`collect_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime} order by b.`device_id`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.`collect_time`,'%H:%00:%00') `collectTime`, a.`electric_a` `electricA`, a.`temperature_a` `temperatureA`, a.`electric_b` `electricB`, a.`temperature_b` `temperatureB`, a.`electric_c` `electricC`, a.`temperature_c` `temperatureC`, a.`power_factor` `powerFactor`, b.`voltage_a` `voltageA`, b.`voltage_b` `voltageD`, b.`voltage_c` `voltageC` FROM `transformer_meter` a LEFT JOIN `power_distribution_box` b ON a.`distribution_device` = b.`device_id` WHERE a.`statistical_method` = 'DISTRIBUTION' AND b.`statistical_method` = 'DISTRIBUTION' and a.`collect_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and b.`collect_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime} and b.`device_id` = #{deviceId} order by a.`collect_time` ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`current_quantity`),0) FROM `transformer_meter` WHERE `statistical_method` = 'ELECTRICITY' and `collect_time` between #{beginTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( `box_electric_total` ), 0 ) FROM `power_distribution_box` WHERE `collect_time` = ( SELECT MAX( `collect_time` ) FROM `power_distribution_box` WHERE `statistical_method` = 'ELECTRICITY' AND `collect_time` BETWEEN #{beginTime} and #{endTime} ) and `statistical_method` = 'ELECTRICITY'
